record.question: Surveyor’s chain length is —
record.explanation: Answer A: 66 feet; 100 links. In Indian land surveying, “surveyor’s chain” conventionally denotes Gunter’s chain; the 100-foot chain is the distinct engineer’s chain. Reviewed unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
record.direction: Follow the printed paper instructions and option order. The source image retains formulas, tables and shared directions.
